name: WebSocket Client
description: Connect to ws:// and wss:// endpoints, watch every message live and send text, JSON, binary or pings
help: Enter a ws:// or wss:// URL and press Connect. Secure connections are verified against the system's trusted certificates.
Open the options to add request headers (for example Authorization or Cookie) and subprotocols such as graphql-ws. The handshake status and negotiated protocol are shown there too.
Received messages are green, sent messages blue, and connection events gray. Click a message to see it in full; JSON is formatted automatically.
Send text or JSON, binary data written as hex or base64, or a ping. Press ⌘/Ctrl + Enter to send. Save payloads you use often as snippets.
The connection keeps running while you use other tools and also appears in the task center. Disconnect sends a normal close frame.
